subject: Structuring credits & metering for Stratagem accelerator pilot

Cc: Stratagem Labs Legal <legal@stratagem.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Structuring credits & metering for accelerator pilot

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Stratagem Labs is excited to run a 3-month accelerator pilot with Redwood Inference starting Aug 2. We've attached our SOW (Stratagem_Pilot_SOW.pdf) with the scope and expected usage profile. Quick highlights:

- Pilot cohort: 6 teams, expected peak concurrency on demo days
- Estimated consumption: ~2M tokens/month initially, spike to ~5M in month 2 depending on demo activity
- Need: promotional onboarding credits and a path to convert to Dedicated later this year

Two asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood provide a startup promo credit to cover the first 6 weeks of expected usage (we're proposing a $12k credit)?
2) Metering & rollover — we'd like any unused portion of the promo credit to roll forward within the 3-month pilot and for overages to bill monthly with a predictable overage rate (is there a dev-friendly overage cap you can offer?).

Also copying our legal contact on the SOW in case you want to attach an addendum. We can be flexible on how the credits are structured (flat promo vs token-based).

Appreciate any quick guidance — demo day is Aug 18 and we'd like billing set up ahead of time.

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Stratagem Labs

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the SOW and the clear usage estimates. This helps. Short answers here and then I'll loop in Ben from Growth for the concrete packaging:

- Promo credit: we can do a startup onboarding credit. I don't have final sign-off on the $12k number yet — need to confirm with Growth/Finance — but we typically model credits against expected token consumption and demo spike profiles.
- Rollover: we support rolling promo balances within a defined pilot window; I'll confirm the exact window (typically 90 days).
- Overage billing: we can set a capped overage rate for the pilot (e.g., X% off published hosted price) to give predictable economics. Ben will propose a concrete tier.

Operational asks for you to unblock us internally: can you confirm the expected monthly split (month1/month2/month3) and whether any teams will require private deployment for data residency? Also, if you can sign and return the SOW with a cover note about credits we can expedite review.

Looping in Ben & Irene to propose a packaging option and legal next steps.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales, Growth Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi Alice —

Great to meet you via Marissa. Based on the SOW and the numbers you provided, here's a pragmatic packaging proposal to keep billing predictable and make conversion to Dedicated straightforward:

Proposal (pilot package):
- Onboarding promo: $10,000 credit applied to hosted API usage, valid for 90 days from activation.
- Monthly minimum billing during pilot: $1,500 (billed monthly) to cover platform & support.
- Overage rate: for token consumption beyond promo + monthly minimum, we'll bill at 40% off our standard hosted rate (this gives you a predictable cap).
- Spike protection: one-time 30% additional credit (up to $2,000) if you can commit demo-day concurrency windows to us in advance.
- Conversion path: if you convert to Dedicated within 120 days, we will: a) apply any remaining promo credit toward the first invoice, and b) extend an introductory 10% discount on committed reserved spend for the first 3 months.

Legal & ops: Irene — can you draft a short addendum that attaches to the SOW reflecting the credit amount, validity window, spike protection and conversion terms? I put together a draft addendum (RI_Draft_Addendum.docx) with placeholder pricing and the HubSpot deal linked below.

If this looks close, Alice, please confirm and we'll generate the addendum + a DocuSign packet. If you need the $12k number instead of $10k, we can escalate but it will require a revenue exception and a ~24–48h approval window.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEL-745
DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/Stratagem-Addendum

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Growth Manager
Redwood Inference

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turn. The package is broadly acceptable to our CFO and program leads. A couple of small asks before we sign:

1) Can the promo credit be token-tracked rather than dollar-tracked so that we can tie it to the usage profile in your console? That helps our internal cost reporting.
2) For the spike protection, would you accept a firm window (Aug 18 09:00–13:00 PST) and cap the extra credit to $2,000 as proposed? We'll commit to the window now.

If you can send the addendum with those two items (token-tracking for promo balance and the spike window included), we'll review and sign the DocuSign. Please send an invoice for the monthly minimum (we'll pay the $1,500 to start the account) and attach the final addendum.

I'll wait for the DocuSign link — keen to get the billing and onboarding scheduled for next week.

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Stratagem Labs
